info.name: M39.2 — Onboarding + Membership Context + Merchant Public Setup
info.description:
# M39.2 — Onboarding + Membership Context + Merchant Public Setup

**Purpose**

This collection covers the second repo-local split milestone after M39.1.

M39.2 owns:
- Owner onboarding (org → branch → profile → settings → invitations)
- Membership context resolution after global Nimbus login
- Manager / Accountant first-login story
- Merchant public-website setup (profile + booking settings + events)
- Merchant public-payment **readiness** (NOT live diner payment execution)

**Deliberately NOT in scope** (deferred to M39.3+):
- Public diner payment execution (still PENDING — MTN / Airtel native)
- SaaS billing or Developer Portal foundations (owned by M39.1, reused here)

## Locked workflow rules
1. Users log into Nimbus globally — there is no "org login" screen.
2. After login, frontend calls `GET /auth/me`. The response includes `memberships[]` and a `context` block.
3. If `context.organizationCount === 1 && context.branchCount === 1` → frontend auto-selects.
4. Otherwise the frontend must prompt the user to pick org + branch.
5. Branch-scoped merchant routes require `x-branch-id`.
6. Owner invites only **Manager** and **Accountant** during onboarding. Other staff (Cashier, Waiter, Chef, Bartender) are added later from inside the app / POS admin — NOT in this wizard.
7. Branch creation reuses M39.1 `BillingService.checkPlanLimit('BRANCH')` location-cap enforcement.
8. Merchant payment readiness is **generic** (NOT_CONFIGURED → PENDING_MTN/PENDING_AIRTEL → READY_FOR_INTEGRATION → LIVE). It is NOT a live diner PesaPal connect.

## Run order
00 → A → B → C → D → E → F → G → H → I

request.description:
**Audience:** anyone running this collection.

**Purpose:** documents the M39.2 storyline. The actual `/health` request is unrelated and just gives you a quick green check that the API is reachable.

**Story (chronological):**
1. **A. Auth & Context** — Owner logs in globally. `GET /auth/me` returns memberships + `context` (auto-select vs prompt).
2. **B. Onboarding Status** — Owner fetches the 7-step wizard state.
3. **C. Org + Branch** — Owner creates the org details + first branch (M39.1 location-cap auto-applies once a subscription exists).
4. **D. Profile + Settings** — Owner fills business profile + currency/timezone/locale.
5. **E. Invitations + First Login** — Owner invites Manager + Accountant. Server creates `User + Membership + UserRole` and returns a one-time `tempPassword`. The invited Manager logs in globally and `GET /auth/me` resolves their branch context.
6. **F. Merchant Public Profile** — Owner fills/publishes the public restaurant profile (branch-scoped, requires `x-branch-id`).
7. **G. Booking Settings** — Owner persists booking rules (deposit policy, max party size, hold minutes) into `PublicProfile.metadata.bookingSettings`.
8. **H. Merchant Events** — Owner creates an event, sets capacity / pricing, then publishes.
9. **I. Merchant Payment Readiness** — Owner declares mobile-money readiness. **No live diner payment is executed** — that is M39.3.

**Audience:** restaurant owner.

**Purpose:** owners log into Nimbus globally. There is no "org login" screen — the org/branch context is resolved on the next request.

**Real-world example:** Olivia visits app.nimbus.co.ug, types her email + password, and the SPA stores the access token.

**Audience:** any logged-in Nimbus user.

**Purpose:** the SPA calls this immediately after `/auth/login`. The response contains:

- `memberships[]` — every active membership with `organizationId/Name/Slug`, `branchId/Name/Slug`, `roleId/Name/Level`, `status`, `isDefaultBranch`.
- `context.organizationCount` / `branchCount` — how many distinct orgs/branches the user belongs to.
- `context.requiresContextSelection` — `true` when the user belongs to >1 orgs OR >1 branches in a single org. The frontend uses this to decide between auto-select vs prompt.
- `context.defaultOrganizationId` / `defaultBranchId` / `defaultMembershipId` — the membership flagged `isDefaultBranch` (or first one).

**Real-world example:** an invited Manager logs in for the first time. Their `/auth/me` returns exactly one membership (their assigned branch). The SPA auto-selects it and stores it as `x-branch-id` for subsequent requests.

**Audience:** the owner running the onboarding wizard.

**Purpose:** returns the 7-step state machine + `progressPercent`. The wizard renders the next incomplete step.

**Real-world example:** Olivia just paid her SOLO subscription. The wizard fetches status — sees `subscriptionPaid: COMPLETED`, `organizationCreated: NOT_STARTED` — and routes her to the org-details screen.

request.description:
**Audience:** owner.

**Purpose:** captures organization-level fields. Throws `409` if `organizationCreated` is already `COMPLETED`.

**Real-world example:** Olivia types her registered restaurant group name and tax ID once; if she refreshes and tries again she gets a 409.

**Audience:** owner.

**Purpose:** creates the first branch. Reuses `BillingService.checkPlanLimit('BRANCH')` from M39.1 — if a subscription already exists, the location cap is enforced before insert. SOLO allows 1, GROWTH ≤3, FRANCHISE ≥4.

**Real-world example:** a SOLO subscriber trying to create a 2nd branch from this endpoint will get a structured `409` with `code: PLAN_LOCATION_LIMIT_REACHED` and `recommendedNextPlan: 'growth'`.

**Audience:** owner.

**Purpose:** captures wider business profile. Marks `businessProfileDone = COMPLETED`.

**Audience:** owner.

**Purpose:** captures core settings. Marks `coreSettingsDone = COMPLETED`.

item.name: E. Team Invitations & First Login Story

request.description:
**Audience:** owner.

**Purpose:** the wizard's invitations step. Server actually creates `User + UserRole + Membership` rows (idempotent on `[userId, branchId]` unique). Returns a one-time `tempPassword` per new invitee plus an `invitationToken` for tracking.

**Constraint:** only `Manager` and `Accountant` roles may be invited here. Cashiers / Waiters / Chefs / Bartenders are added LATER from inside the app — submitting any other role returns `400`.

**Real-world example:** Olivia hands her bookkeeper Aaron the `tempPassword` over a secure channel; Aaron logs in at `/auth/login` and is auto-prompted to change his password on first use.

if (err) { console.log('E.2 pre-request: invite failed', err); return resolve(); }
console.log('E.2 pre-request: minted fresh manager', mgr.email);
console.log('E.2 pre-request: invite returned no tempPassword', body);
} catch (e) { console.log('E.2 pre-request: parse error', e); }
pm.test('Skipped (could not mint manager — owner token missing)', () => pm.expect(true).to.be.true);

request.description:
**Audience:** invited Manager.

**Purpose:** demonstrates the invited user's first-login flow. They log in globally — exactly the same endpoint as the Owner. There is NO separate "join an organization" screen.

**Real-world example:** Mary clicks the invite link in her email, lands on the standard login page, types her email + temp password, gets a token.

item.name: E.3 — Manager GET /auth/me — auto-resolve branch context

request.description:
**Audience:** invited Manager (just logged in).

**Purpose:** her `/auth/me` returns exactly one membership (the branch the Owner pinned her to during invitation). `context.requiresContextSelection` is `false`, so the SPA auto-selects org + branch and stores `x-branch-id` for all subsequent merchant calls.

**Real-world example:** Mary is dropped straight into the Tapas Downtown branch dashboard with no extra prompts.

**Audience:** owner / manager.

**Purpose:** branch-scoped public-profile upsert. The `slug` is auto-generated from `displayName`. Audited as `PUBLIC_PROFILE_UPDATED`.

**Real-world example:** Mary uploads the restaurant's logo + opening hours so diners on booking.nimbus.co.ug see real info.

**Audience:** owner / manager.

**Purpose:** flips the profile from `DRAFT` to `PUBLISHED` and stamps `publishedAt`. Audited as `PUBLIC_PROFILE_PUBLISHED`. After this, `GET /public/restaurants/:slug` returns it to diners.

**Audience:** owner / manager.

**Purpose:** persists booking rules into `PublicProfile.metadata.bookingSettings`. Auto-creates a DRAFT profile if none exists yet so settings can be configured before publishing. Audited as `MERCHANT_BOOKING_SETTINGS_UPDATED`.

**Real-world example:** Mary configures "15-minute hold, max party 12, 2-hour lead time" so the diner reservation flow on booking.nimbus.co.ug enforces those rules.

exec: // Ensure eventId (and branchId) are populated for H.2 / H.3 / H.4 even when run standalone.
if (!baseUrl || !token) { console.log('H pre-request: missing baseUrl or accessToken — collection auto-login may have failed.'); return; }
function setVar(k, v) { pm.collectionVariables.set(k, v); if (pm.environment && pm.environment.set) pm.environment.set(k, v); }
pm.sendRequest({ url: baseUrl + '/api/auth/me', method: 'GET', header: headersBase }, function (err, res) {
if (err || !res) { console.log('H pre-request: /auth/me failed', err); return cb(null); }
} catch (e) { console.log('H pre-request: /auth/me parse error', e); cb(null); }
if (!branchId) { console.log('H pre-request: cannot resolve branchId — run C.1/C.2 first or check /auth/me.'); return done(); }
pm.sendRequest({ url: baseUrl + '/api/merchant/events', method: 'GET', header: headers }, function (listErr, listRes) {
console.log('H pre-request: reused existing event', items[0].id);
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ title: 'Auto Event ' + Date.now(), description: 'Auto-created by H pre-request', startsAt: startsAt, endsAt: endsAt, capacity: 40, isFree: true }) }
} else { console.log('H pre-request: create returned no id', createRes.code, body); }
} else { console.log('H pre-request: create failed', createErr); }
} catch (e) { console.log('H pre-request: parse error', e); }
return new Promise(function (resolve) { ensureBranchId(function (branchId) { ensureEventId(branchId, resolve); }); });

request.description:
**Audience:** owner / manager.

**Purpose:** creates a `PublicEvent` in DRAFT. Audited as `PUBLIC_EVENT_CREATED`.

**Real-world example:** Mary schedules the spring wine night three weeks ahead. Capacity 40, free for now (she'll set pricing in H.3).

**Audience:** owner / manager.

**Purpose:** raise capacity. Validates capacity ≥ current `bookedCount` to prevent over-booked states. Audited as `PUBLIC_EVENT_CAPACITY_UPDATED`.

**Audience:** owner / manager.

**Purpose:** flip to paid and set price. If `isFree: false` you MUST have a positive price (either in this body or already on the row). Audited as `PUBLIC_EVENT_PRICING_UPDATED`.

**Note:** paid event bookings still cannot be confirmed end-to-end — diner payment execution is M39.3.

**Audience:** owner / manager.

**Purpose:** publish the event so it shows up on booking.nimbus.co.ug. Audited as `PUBLIC_EVENT_PUBLISHED`.

body.raw: { "readiness": "PENDING_MTN", "notes": "MTN merchant code applied for; awaiting approval." }

request.description:
**Audience:** owner.

**Purpose:** declares the restaurant's intent to one day collect mobile-money payments from diners. Provider is `MOBILE_MONEY` (NOT PesaPal — PesaPal is reserved for SaaS billing). `live: false` always at this stage. Audited as `MERCHANT_PAYMENT_CONNECT_INITIATED`.

body.raw: { "readiness": "READY_FOR_INTEGRATION", "notes": "MTN merchant code received. Awaiting Nimbus engineer to wire adapter." }

request.description:
**Audience:** owner.

**Purpose:** owner advances the readiness state once the merchant code is in hand. Only a Nimbus engineer can flip it to `LIVE` after the mobile-money adapter is deployed. Audited as `MERCHANT_PAYMENT_CONFIG_UPDATED`.

**Audience:** owner / manager dashboard.

**Purpose:** returns `{ configured, provider, readiness, live, notes, message }`. `live` stays `false` until M39.3 lands the diner payment execution. The `provider` is always `MOBILE_MONEY` for this domain — the dashboard MUST NOT label this as PesaPal.
